rules.title: Remote Script Piped to Shell
rules.description: Command downloads remote content and pipes it into a shell.
rules.false_positive_notes: Common in legit installers (brew, rustup); verify the domain.

rules.title: Reverse Shell Pattern
rules.description: Command matches a common reverse-shell construction.
rules.false_positive_notes: Almost never legitimate from an AI agent.

rules.title: Cloud Metadata Endpoint
rules.description: Command targets the instance metadata service.
rules.false_positive_notes: Cloud tooling queries metadata legitimately on cloud hosts.

rules.title: Write to authorized_keys
rules.description: Command appends to an SSH authorized_keys file — persistence.

rules.title: Scheduled-Task Persistence
rules.description: Command installs a cron job or launchd/systemd unit.

rules.title: Shell History Cleared
rules.description: Command clears or disables shell history.
rules.false_positive_notes: Rare legitimate use; strong anti-forensic signal.

rules.title: World-Writable/Exec Permission
rules.false_positive_notes: Sloppy but common in dev; context matters.

rules.title: Package Published to Registry
rules.false_positive_notes: Routine in release workflows; supply-chain relevance.

rules.title: Destructive Disk Operation
rules.description: Command performs a raw disk write or filesystem format.

rules.title: Environment Dumped Over Network
rules.description: Command sends the full environment over the network.
rules.false_positive_notes: Debug workflows occasionally do this; check destination.
